newsitem.title: FINLAND: Metra hits all-time high in brisk demand.
newsitem.headline: Metra hits all-time high in brisk demand.

text.p: Shares in Finnish engineering group Metra Oy Ab continued to rise in fair trade early on Friday with some upside seen left after Thursday's gains, brokers said.
Metra's announcement on Thursday of a planned merger of its Wartsila Diesel unit with Italian Fincantieri's diesel engine operations was viewed positively, brokers said.

At 1130/0830 GMT, Metra B traded at an all-time high 255.00 markka, up seven markka or almost three percent. Metra's less liquid A shares were up one markka at 251.00. The aggregate volume was fair for Metra at little over four million markka.
"The share could extend gains, news of the merger has generated positive vibes in the market," one broker said.
